connect  [stable · new-user]
Purpose:
  Plan and set a profile's desired direct or
  proxied connection.

Usage:
  hideout connect directly [for profile <name>] [--yes]
  hideout connect through <proxy-secret> [using <resolver>] [for profile <name>] [--yes]
  hideout connect plan --profile <name> (--direct | --through <proxy-secret> [--dns <resolver>])
  hideout connect apply <operation-id> [--yes]

Flags:
  --profile <name>
      select the affected profile in plan mode
  --direct
      plan direct networking
  --through <ref>
      plan a daemon-managed proxy secret
      reference
  --dns <ip>
      select the mediated resolver in plan mode
  --yes
      confirm the exact displayed plan
      non-interactively

Examples:
  hideout connect directly
  hideout connect through local-proxy using 1.1.1.1
  hideout connect plan --profile default --through local-proxy --dns 1.1.1.1

Before:
  For a proxied connection, first store the
  exact ref with `hideout secret set <ref>`.
  One-release compatibility applies only to
  legacy HIDEOUT_SECRET_<REF> exports.
  The daemon startup environment is the only
  legacy source.
  Exports made after daemon start cannot apply.
  Migrate with `hideout secret set <ref>`.

Effects:
  Planning is read-only. Confirmed apply changes
  desired connection state; the result says
  whether activation is live or pending the next
  eligible attach.

Safety:
  The canonical diff, effects, blockers, and
  rollback are displayed before confirmation.
  A privacy connection fails closed when its
  proxy secret or mediated resolver cannot be
  proved; it never silently falls back to
  direct.

Recovery:
  Inspect the exact operation in `hideout tui`;
  restore with a newly reviewed
  `hideout connect directly` plan or the prior
  proved proxy ref.

Next:
  hideout show connection
  hideout doctor --network tun2socks --proxy-secret <ref> --mediated-resolver <ip>
